_comment: Store profile: the routing taxonomy as DATA, not code.
Structure follows how dealerships actually organise: Fixed Operations (service, parts,
body shop) and Variable Operations (sales, F&I). Tires and detailing are SERVICE SUB-QUEUES,
not peer departments; roadside is a policy flag, not a place. A store with no body shop
deletes that destination; a store with its own tire centre promotes it to level 1 by moving
Edit this file per store. No code changes required.
